env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=

env CGO_ENABLED=

[cgo] go build -o g-go.bin .
[cgo] logos build -o g-logos.bin .
[cgo] logos env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^1$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("g:", C.answer()) }
